events.event_name: Smart Fashion Day @ New York Fashion Week
events.address: Adelphi University - Manhattan Center, 529 5th Ave, New York, NY 10173
events.what_it_is: A Fashion Tech event with AI startup pitches, industry feedback and curated networking for fashion, luxury, retail and e-commerce professionals.
events.what_is_free: The listed general-attendance path is free, but attendees must request access and host approval is required.
events.caveats: Luma currently marks General Admission as Require Approval and uses a Request to Join flow. This is not an ordinary open free RSVP, and acceptance is not guaranteed.
events.practical_notes: Monday, September 14 from 3:30–6:30 PM. Request access through the official Luma page and wait for organizer approval before treating attendance as confirmed.

events.event_name: National Voter Registration Day NYC Block Party
events.address: LaGuardia Pl by Washington Square Park, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: HeadCount's National Voter Registration Day block party with live music, art, voter-registration resources and brand activations beside Washington Square Park.
events.what_is_free: Public admission is free. Current event coverage advertises brand freebies, chocolate and complimentary product samples alongside the civic programming, while supplies last.
events.caveats: Current sources agree on September 15 from 10 AM–6 PM and describe the event as free and public. BroadwayWorld places the block party on LaGuardia Place between West 4th and West 3rd Streets, adjacent to Washington Square Park. Promotional freebies are inventory-dependent.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 10 AM–6 PM beside Washington Square Park on LaGuardia Place. No RSVP requirement is published.

events.event_name: goop kitchen Downtown Brooklyn VIP Preview
events.what_it_is: A pre-opening preview for goop kitchen's Downtown Brooklyn location offering complimentary meals for pickup or delivery to selected nearby neighborhoods.
events.what_is_free: The live sign-up form advertises a complimentary meal for preview participants. Spots are limited.
events.caveats: The official Tally form is live and says spots are limited. Signing up does not itself select a pickup/delivery slot; participants are told they will be notified by email to choose a time. Current public listings describe the preview as September 16–17, but they publish the overall two-day window rather than separate date-specific daily hours, so no unsupported per-day closing time is invented.
events.practical_notes: Sign up through the live preview form. The public listing covers September 16–17 at 383 Bridge Street with pickup/delivery service in nearby Brooklyn neighborhoods; wait for the follow-up email before treating a meal slot as confirmed.
